subject: {first_name}, I built this after one too many Telegram "sure things"
preview_text: A chart should become a setup — entry, stop, targets — not another opinion.
body_paragraphs: Every cycle, the same scene plays out: group chats full of screenshots and certainty — "this is the bottom," "easy 10x," "trust me bro." Almost nobody writing down invalidation, size, or what would prove them wrong.

I built Predictify Crypto because trading arguments shouldn't be won by whoever posts the loudest chart. We wanted something you can pressure-test: structure from your screenshot, levels you can verify, and a confidence score you can compare against your journal.

A friend of ours learned this the hard way on a late-night pump. The model returned NO_TRADE with a mid confidence band — basically "don't force it." He ignored it, chased the candle, and got stopped out twice. Two weeks later he scanned a clean setup, respected the stop, and logged the trade in the journal. Same friend. Different process.
That's why we care about the loop: scan → setup → journal → streak. Not hidden tips. Not rewriting history after the move.
Your next step takes about 30 seconds: open Command, unlock analysis if you haven't, and scan one chart you actually trade. Read the stop before you size.
P.S. This is not financial advice and we don't guarantee outcomes. Gut feel is fun in Telegram. A written stop is better before you click buy.
